questions.question: When hungry Jesus saw a leafy tree in the distance and went to look for fruit on it, what kind of tree was it?
When Jesus entered the temple courts in Jerusalem and found people buying and selling there, what did He do?

answers.text: He began to drive them out
He sat down and watched them
He bought a dove for an offering

questions.question: Jesus said God's house should be called a house of prayer for all the nations. What did He say the people had made it?
Jesus taught that when you stand to pray and hold something against another person, what should you do?

answers.text: Forgive what you hold against them
